statement: For proper convex LSC f,g, the displayed HJ-Prox PDHG updates using prox(g*) and prox(f), with tau*sigma*||A||^2<1 and the stated schedules, converge almost surely to a minimizer of f(x)+g(Ax).
acceptance: FALSIFIED if the displayed conjugate and primal updates are well-defined, every printed condition holds, and the objective has no minimizer with divergent primal iterates.
